## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A seven-*juan* late-Míng running commentary on the Lotus Sūtra by [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) Hānshān Déqīng 憨山德清 (1546–1623), one of the *Míngmò sìdà gāosēng* 明末四大高僧. The work is the longer companion to Déqīng's synoptic *Jījié* ([KR6d0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0076), X31n0610): the *Jījié* providing the synoptic accent on selected passages, the *Tōngyì* providing the comprehensive running commentary on the entire Lotus.

**Abstract**

The *Tōngyì* is the principal late-Míng monastic Lotus Sūtra running commentary outside the Tiāntái scholastic tradition. Its method combines (1) Hānshān Déqīng's distinctive Chán–Yogācāra–Tathāgatagarbha synthetic doctrinal framework; (2) sustained engagement with the Tiāntái commentarial tradition (particularly [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ's *Wénjù* (*Fǎhuá wénjù* 法華文句 [KR6d0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0014)) and [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) Zhànrán's *Wénjù jì* (*Fǎhuá wénjù jì* 法華文句記 [KR6d0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0015))); (3) integration of Huāyán and Sānlùn interpretive perspectives; and (4) Déqīng's characteristic philological-experiential reading style.

The work belongs to the broader late-Wànlì revival of Mahāyāna scholastic commentary outside the institutional school traditions: where Tiāntái commentary in the late Míng was largely produced by Tiāntái-affiliated monks (Yōuxī [傳燈](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%82%B3%E7%87%88) Chuándēng, [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) Ǒuyì Zhìxù), Déqīng's commentary represents the parallel Chán–Pure-Land–Yogācāra synthetic tradition's engagement with the Lotus. Together with Zhìxù's *Huìyì* ([KR6d0082](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0082)) and the parallel commentaries by [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4) Tōngrùn ([KR6d0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0080)) and [圓澄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%BE%84) Yuánchéng ([KR6d0079](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0079)), the *Tōngyì* represents the principal late-Míng non-Tiāntái Lotus Sūtra commentary.

The composition is bracketed within Déqīng's productive period c. 1590–1623, with the work most plausibly placed in his post-exile productive years c. 1612–1623 at Cáoxī 曹溪.
